Perfect! After Rg8+ and any king move (Kh5, Kh4, or Kh3), Black plays Rh7# which is checkmate. This is the clearly best move.

**Best move:** Rg8+

**Main line:** Rg8+ Kh5 Rh7#

**Motif:** backRankMate

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king is trapped on the back rank, look for forcing checks that drive it to an even worse square. Here, Rg8+ forces the king to move, and then Rh7 is unstoppable checkmate—the rook on g8 controls h8 so the king can't escape. Always check if your checks set up an immediate back-rank mate threat.
